notes.title: ChipWits 0.65.4 Beta - Feature Release
notes.notes:
Highlights
This new feature release includes some bug fixes and several significant improvements, most notably:
* Ultra-wide monitor support and support for all aspect ratios
* Improved keyboard support, including more shortcut keys and "Quick Buffers"
* Top 10 scores are now available in the histogram view (as well as the ability to not share yours)
* The ability to drag the camera around with the middle mouse or Command+Left button

Press the Field Manual button during the game to see all available hotkeys

New Features
* #883: [SCORE]: Make it more clear when the player matches top score in the category
* #890: [USABILITY]: Hotkey page
* #891: Alt + arrows changes true connector direction
* #892: [HOTKEY]: PgUp, PgDn switches between SubPanels
* #906: Support for ultra-wide monitors, and improve support for all aspect ratios in game and puzzle selection screens 
* #920: Drag the camera around with middle mouse or Command+Left button
* #924: Show top 10 scores in histogram view
* #929: Ask user if they want to be notified when new puzzles come out
* #931: [MANUAL]: Make it explicit when the game will open the browser to chipwits.com/docs
* #934: Show "Top", "All Equal", "Top x%", or "Bottom x%" as appropriate (and don't show "Top 0%")
* #935: Add noSpawn marker option to mission file format to prevent items from spawning on some tiles
* #937: Ctrl+Left Click should have the same behavior as right-click for computers with no right mouse button
* Improve keyboard behavior:
  * Add shortcut keys to all action menus
  * Restore selection after modal dialog
  * Ensure a default button selected when modal dialog opens
  * Select chip grid when mission starts, by default
* Quick Buffers: Alt 1-8 copies selected chips into a persistent buffer, 1-8 pastes
* Enable not submitting scores, not showing name in options. Show steam names in top 10
* Update Copyright to 2025

Bug Fixes
* #832: [DEMO]: Audio: User reported: The clicks in Video Settings" are extremely loud compared to everywhere else
* #881: BUG: Fall does not animate when speed > 16X
* #905: [DEMO]: [CRASH]: [40th Anniversary Puzzle]: Hitting escape twice while level is underway puts the game into a strange level state which eventually causes game to crash
* #906: [RESOLUTION]: On 3440x1440 resolution screen/text is cut off
* #936: [LOC]: Percentages for scoreboard show up as tofu box for some locales
* Fix animation of objective met dialog

notes.title: Version 0.48-beta4
notes.notes:
Note: This version of the game has been tuned to be very sensitive to game state getting out of sync,
or any other errors / warnings. It is configured to eagerly crash so that we can better find issues.
If there are >= 100 errors / warnings in the logs, the game will automatically crash.

There are several new features that will make it easier for you to report issues as a Beta tester.
In particular, pressing Shift+F12 during the game will force-crash the game and give you the option
to submit a report which will include a screenshot and all the info we need to reproduce the issue on
our side.

notes.title: Update notes for v0.43-beta3
notes.notes:
This is a major new release, and the first release fully integrated with Steam.

Major new features:
* Completely remove dependency on proprietary ChipWits Server and Integrate with Steam SDK instead
* Load missions from local disk instead of server, allowing the game to work without a network connection
* Save game state syncs with Steam Cloud
* Rendering of full Station West in Droog Station Map
* Mission authoring can be done in a single file per mission, instead of a separate metadata file
* Missions can be digitally signed to ensure authenticity
* Support for DLC missions (future add-ons)
* Support for Steam Workshop Missions (player-contributed), though no way for players to publish, yet
* Support for local missions in "My Documents" folder
* Official Puzzles are published as signed Steam Workshop Missions
* Mission binaries now also contain the source code for the mission, making it possible to fork missions, later
* Record steam stats on hours played for each mission
* Steam leaderboard support
* Global standings dialog, with histograms comparing your performance to other players
* Enable missions that let you go past the minimum objective criteria
* Ability to copy and paste ChipWits to the System clipboard

Improvements:
* Scroll triangle is more visible
* Remove puzzle loading scene and game loading scenes, making things snappier
* Auto refresh local missions when switching focus back to game
* Copy error messages to clipboard
* Missions can now have arbitrary completion criteria (e.g. "pick up 2 pies or zap 3 electrocrabs")
* Better handling of Esc key, including skipping prelude and skipping dialogue
* Refactored into a state machine design, to improve stability and debuggability
* Enable turning on / off music in dev mode
* Make node hit boxes larger on map screen
* Loop no longer counted against you as a chip
